screen.oldrepublic.standing.title: Standing
screen.oldrepublic.standing.unlock.jedi_: Trusted: a Jedi may sit the Trial of the Blade. Above Distrusted: Master Saelen will still hear an Independent. Honoured: Knight (later).
screen.oldrepublic.standing.unlock.sith_: Trusted: a Sith may sit the Trial of Ascension. Above Distrusted: Overseer Sorn will still hear an Independent. Honoured: Lord (later).
screen.oldrepublic.standing.unlock.front: Trusted: freed settlers leave a bundle of supplies. Distrusted or worse: settlers flee on sight and will not talk.
screen.oldrepublic.standing.unlock.repub: Neutral: Republic officers offer missions. Trusted: troopers salute and defend you. Distrusted: patrols warn you off. Hostile: they fire on sight.
screen.oldrepublic.standing.no_path: Your road is not yet chosen. The Crossing waits.
screen.oldrepublic.standing.independent_: You walk your own way and answer to no master. A mentor may still take you on if their order is not Distrusted and your alignment does not oppose them.
screen.oldrepublic.standing.req.later.je: Knight: Honoured standing with the Jedi Order. Not yet within reach.
screen.oldrepublic.standing.req.later.si: Lord: Honoured standing with the Sith Empire. Not yet within reach.
screen.oldrepublic.standing.req.trial.je: Then pass the Trial of the Blade
screen.oldrepublic.standing.req.trial.si: Then pass the Trial of Ascension
screen.oldrepublic.standing.no_mentor: No mentor has taken you on.
message.oldrepublic.identity.yield_promp: %s yields. Use them to decide, or strike again to execute.
message.oldrepublic.identity.yield_not_y: %s has yielded, but the choice is not yours.
message.oldrepublic.identity.captive_not: They are waiting for someone else.
message.oldrepublic.identity.captive_wai: They have seen your choice. They look away.
message.oldrepublic.identity.settler_ref: The settler backs away from you.
message.oldrepublic.identity.settler_gre: "Good to see you, friend. The frontier remembers."
dialogue.oldrepublic.yield.plea: Enough... enough. I yield, %s. Whatever happens next is your choice.
dialogue.oldrepublic.yield.opt.spare: Go. Live with what you have done.
dialogue.oldrepublic.yield.opt.execute: You will not get another chance to hurt anyone.
dialogue.oldrepublic.yield.spare_confirm: You mean it? You will let me walk away?
dialogue.oldrepublic.yield.execute_confi: Then do it. I will not beg twice.
dialogue.oldrepublic.captives.plea: Please, cut these ropes before they come back. We have homesteads past the ridge, families waiting.
dialogue.oldrepublic.captives.opt.free: Hold still. I will cut you loose.
dialogue.oldrepublic.captives.who: Poachers, and a hired blade with a red sword. They took our carts, then us. Said we would dig crystal for them.
dialogue.oldrepublic.captives.confirm_fr: Bless you. We will run straight home, and we will not forget this.
dialogue.oldrepublic.captives.confirm_pa: Pay? We have little enough... Fine. Take what we carry, just get us out of these ropes.
dialogue.oldrepublic.captives.confirm_le: You would leave us here? Tied up, for when they come back?
title.oldrepublic.pathfinder.desc: No one names you. You named yourself, at Courier's Fall.
title.oldrepublic.keeper_of_echoes.desc: Every holocron on the frontier has spoken to you.
Ready: the Compass waits at Courier's Fall.
